# Submission checklist

**Name:**  
**Task:** G0 audit / severity / outcome / recovery / adjudication / paper support  
**Batch:**  
**Date:**  
**Guide:** [`docs/COAUTHOR_GUIDE.md`](../COAUTHOR_GUIDE.md)

---

## Before you submit

- [ ] I used the correct template from `docs/templates/`.
- [ ] I saved a copy with my initials.
- [ ] I did not edit the original batch file.
- [ ] The header row is unchanged.
- [ ] Every row has a label or pass/fail value.
- [ ] No label is blank.
- [ ] I used only the exact label strings from the rubric.
- [ ] I filled `confidence_1_5` and `notes` for hard cases.
- [ ] I did not put PII in `notes`.
- [ ] The row count matches the batch manifest.
- [ ] I did not discuss individual labels with the other rater before submission.

## Submission

- [ ] Uploaded to the shared annotation folder.
- [ ] Posted the file name and row count in the GitHub issue.
- [ ] Told Author 3 that the batch is complete.

## If something is wrong

- [ ] I reported the problem to Author 3.
- [ ] I did not guess a label to fill a row.
- [ ] I did not change the rubric alone.
